_meta.indication: Picato gel is indicated for the topical treatment of actinic keratosis (0.015% for face and scalp; 0.05% for trunk and extremities)

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, parallel group, double blind, vehicle controlled study of PEP005 Gel 0.015% in adults ≥18 years with AKs on the face or scalp
pivotal_trials.population: Adults at least 18 years old with 4-8 clinically typical, visible, discrete actinic keratosis lesions within a contiguous 25 cm2 treatment area on the head
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Complete clearance of AK lesions at the Day 57 visit
pivotal_trials.result: Complete clearance (ITT) 50/135 (37%) with PICATO 0.015% vs 3/134 (2.2%) vehicle; superior to vehicle, p<0.0001

nct_ctgov.title: A Multi-center Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of PEP005 (Ingenol Mebutate) Gel, When Used to Treat Actinic Keratoses on the Head (Face or Scalp)

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, parallel group, double blind, vehicle controlled study of PEP005 Gel 0.015% for AKs of the face/scalp; design similar to Study 016
pivotal_trials.population: Adults at least 18 years old with 4-8 discrete actinic keratosis lesions within a contiguous 25 cm2 treatment area on the head
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Complete clearance of AK lesions at the Day 57 visit
pivotal_trials.result: Complete clearance (ITT) 67/142 (47.2%) with PICATO 0.015% vs 7/136 (5.2%) vehicle; superior to vehicle, p<0.0001

nct_ctgov.title: A Multi-Center Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of PEP005 (Ingenol Mebutate) Gel, When Used to Treat Actinic Keratoses on the Head (Face or Scalp)

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, double blind, randomized, vehicle controlled parallel group study of PEP005 Gel 0.05% for AKs on the trunk/extremities, applied once daily for 2 consecutive days
pivotal_trials.population: Adults at least 18 years old with 4-8 discrete actinic keratosis lesions within a contiguous 25 cm2 treatment area on a non-head area (trunk or extremities)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Complete clearance of AK lesions at the Day 57 visit
pivotal_trials.result: Complete clearance (ITT) 35/126 (28%) with PICATO 0.05% vs 6/129 (5%) vehicle; superior to vehicle, p<0.0001

nct_ctgov.title: A Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of PEP005 (Ingenol Mebutate) Gel When Used to Treat Actinic Keratoses (AKs) on the Non Head Locations

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, double blind, randomized, vehicle controlled parallel group study of PEP005 Gel 0.05% for AKs on the trunk/extremities, applied once daily for 2 consecutive days
pivotal_trials.population: Adults at least 18 years old with 4-8 discrete actinic keratosis lesions within a contiguous 25 cm2 treatment area on a non-head area (trunk or extremities)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Complete clearance of AK lesions at the Day 57 visit
pivotal_trials.result: Complete clearance (ITT) 42/100 (42%) with PICATO 0.05% vs 5/103 (5%) vehicle; superior to vehicle, p<0.0001

nct_ctgov.title: A Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of PEP005 (Ingenol Mebutate) Gel When Used to Treat Actinic Keratoses (AKs) on the Non Head Locations

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥2%) are local skin reactions, application site pain, pruritus, irritation and infection, periorbital edema, nasopharyngitis and headache. Face/scalp (0.015%, N=274): application site pain 42 (15%), pruritus 22 (8%), periorbital edema 7 (3%); trunk/extremities (0.05%, N=225): pruritus 18 (8%), irritation 8 (4%). Eye/ocular disorders and severe local skin reactions can occur.
target_moa: Ingenol mebutate induces cell death when applied topically to actinic keratoses via a dual mechanism of local lesional cell death and promotion of an inflammatory response (neutrophil infiltration); the precise mechanism is unknown
modality: Small molecule (new molecular entity) topical gel

rems.type: FDA recommended no Postmarketing Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies for this application

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held for this application

description.text: Added labeling describing response to a repeat course of Picato Gel 0.015% on the face or scalp for incomplete response

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application proposes updated labeling describing response to a repeat course of Picato Gel, 0.015% on the face or scalp if an incomplete response is observed at a follow-up examination.

summary.text: PICATO (ingenol mebutate) was approved as a new molecular entity for topical treatment of actinic keratosis based on four Phase 3 vehicle-controlled pivotal trials; no advisory committee was convened, no REMS was required, and FDA recommended no additional postmarketing requirements or commitments.

citations.quote: This application provides for the approval of a new molecular entity, ingenol mebutate, to be used for the topical treatment of actinic keratoses.
No advisory committee meeting was held for this application. The application did not raise issues of safety or efficacy that would require discussion before an advisory committee.
Recommendation for other Postmarketing Requirements and Commitments – None
